build_HFTextEncoder: build a python module that loads a HuggingFace sentence transformer model and encodes text into embeddings
create_HFTextEncoder_with_fp16: create an HFTextEncoder instance that encodes text to numpy arrays using fp16 precision for memory efficiency
run_HFTextEncoder_encode_to_np: run the encode_to_np method to convert an iterator of numbered text lines into a numpy embedding array
review_HFTextEncoder_name_output_file: review the name_output_file method that generates the output file path using shard ID extraction
test_HFTextEncoder_context_manager: test the HFTextEncoder as a context manager that properly opens and closes the output embedding file
